\section{Professional Summary}
Client-focused Software Engineer with 6+ years at Mastercard building payment-domain Java/Spring, REST API, Oracle, React/TypeScript, CI/CD, testing, and observability systems. I bring the ownership style Worldpay values: turning product needs into clear technical specs, explaining pros and costs to product, QA, release, support, and engineering stakeholders, and keeping quality, maintainability, and technical debt visible through the full lifecycle. Built resilience patterns across 5+ microservices, reduced production MTTR from days to hours, improved WCAG compliance by 40\% while coaching 10+ teams, and delivered secure card-data transmission through MDES tokenisation and HSM integration.
